title: The bench calibrator
summary: Our most-used instrument: a four-channel bench calibrator accurate to 0.02% of reading across the full range.
body: The NW-400 replaced the NW-380 in 2023 and shares its mounting footprint, so an existing bench does not need rebuilding. Four independent channels, each individually certified. The display is readable at two metres, which matters more on a production line than any specification sheet will tell you.
author: sam whitfield
